title: Ghost in the History
description:
A fictional compromised host was imaged for forensics. The analyst found this excerpt in `~/.bash_history`:

```
mkdir -p /tmp/.cache/ops
scp analyst@10.20.0.9:/srv/reports/reports.zip /tmp/.cache/hold.dat
unzip -q /tmp/.cache/hold.dat -d /tmp/.cache/ops
rm -rf /tmp/.cache/ops /tmp/.cache/hold.dat
```

The staging archive was moved under a different name before deletion.
objective: Submit the hidden staging filename as HC{filename}.

hints.text: Follow the scp destination path, not the original source name.
